items.q: Are you really on the bike path?
items.a: Yes. The shop is right on the Adirondack Rail Trail. Drive in, park, get on your bike and ride straight onto the trail.

items.q: How long is the rail trail?
items.a: About 34 miles, from Lake Placid to Tupper Lake, through Ray Brook and Saranac Lake. It's packed stone most of the way and paved through Saranac Lake village.

items.q: How far can I get in 2 hours?
items.a: Saranac Lake is about 9 miles from Lake Placid. On an e-bike you can ride there and back in about 2 hours if you keep moving. For an easy pace with stops, turn around around Ray Brook.
